name: Temple High Priest (Human Cleric 11)
source: The War of the Goblin King
book: The War of the Goblin King

facets.bk: The War of the Goblin King

body:
Temple High Priest

CR 10

XP 9,600
Male human cleric 11
NG Medium humanoid (human)
Init -1; Senses Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 9, touch 9, flat-footed 9 (-1 Dex)
hp 75 (11d8+22)
Fort +5, Ref +8, Will +6

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee masterwork quarterstaff +9 (1d6+1)
Special Attacks channel positive energy (10/day, 6d6, Will DC 18), rebuke death (8/day), nimbus of light (11 rounds/day)
Cleric Spells Prepared (CL 11th; concentration +16)

6th—healD (2)
5th—breath of lifeD, raise dead (3)
4th—cure critical woundsD, divination, restoration (3)
3rd—create food and water, cure serious woundsD, remove blindness/deafness, remove curse, remove disease (2)
2nd—cure moderate woundsD, lesser restoration (3), remove paralysis (2)
1st—bless water (4), cure light woundsD, detect undead (2)
0—detect poison, mending, purify food and drink, stabilize

D domain spell Domains Healing, Sun

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 8, Con 14, Int 10, Wis 20, Cha 16
Base Atk +8; CMB +9; CMD 18
Feats Combat Casting, Extra Channel (2), Great Fortitude, Improved Iron Will, Iron Will, Toughness
Skills Diplomacy +17, Heal +19, Knowledge (religion) +14, Sense Motive +19, Spellcraft +14
Languages Common
SQ aura, healer’s blessing, orisons, sun’s blessing
NPC Gear cloak of resistance +1, headband of mental prowess (Wis, Cha) +2, masterwork quarterstaff, restorative ointment, wand of cure light wounds (50 charges)
